title: MusicFlow v5.0.0
releaseNotes: New Fluent design: navigation menu, large page titles, pivots, a full-width player bar with the progress line on top
Now Playing page with the scrubber, time left and full transport under the artwork
Accent colour of your choice in Settings (Blue, Green, Purple, Red, Orange, Teal, Leaf); Light, Dark or Auto
Station engine: autoplay, radio and Related never repeat a song and stay in the song's language and artist circle
Search rebuilt: one entry per recording, the original album first, artists and albums as top results
MusicFlow's own lock-screen controls, Android status-bar fixes and faster start-up
Web app for iPhone and Safari: open the site's web app and add it to your home screen
signingNote: Versions 2.7.3 and older were signed with a different key: uninstall them before installing 5.0.0.

ios.note: Sideload only. On iPhone, open the site itself in Safari and Add to Home Screen.
